question.problem: Construct the vector field that has the stream function $ψ(x,y)={x}^{2}{e}^{1-y}.$
question.worked_solution:
A function $ψ(x,y)$ is a stream function of the vector field $F=P\,i+Q\,j$ if the following equations hold:

$$
P=\frac{∂ψ}{∂y},\,Q=-\frac{∂ψ}{∂x}
$$

Computing the partial derivatives of the function $ψ(x,y),$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P & =\frac{∂ψ}{∂y} \\  & =\frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{2}{e}^{1-y}) \\  & =-{x}^{2}{e}^{1-y}, \\ Q & =-\frac{∂ψ}{∂x} \\  & =-\frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{2}{e}^{1-y}) \\  & =-2x{e}^{1-y}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the vector field with the stream function $ψ(x,y)={x}^{2}{e}^{1-y}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}F(x,y) & =P\,i+Q\,j \\  & =-{x}^{2}{e}^{1-y}\,i-2x{e}^{1-y}\,j.\end{aligned}
$$
